svg.title: ReqToTokenPool and the KV pool
svg.desc: req_to_token maps each request row and token position to a KV slot. Rows for B and C both start with slots 1 to 4, the shared prefix. The KV pool stores K and V per layer at each slot. For a decode step the ForwardBatch carries req_pool_indices, seq_lens and out_cache_loc, the slots this step writes.
svg.text: [req_pool_idx, position] → KV slot index · int32 on GPU
B AND C ROWS HOLD THE SAME SLOTS 1–4 · SHARED PREFIX S0–S3
KV pool (one K and one V tensor per layer)
SLOT 0 IS RESERVED FOR PADDED WRITES · FREE SLOTS LIVE IN A GPU TENSOR
seq_lens = [8, 8] # tokens per request after this step
out_cache_loc = [11, 12] # where this step writes new K and V
